              Build.cpp, Test.cpp  (upstream CLIs; not linked)

              libcds/src/static/"bitsequence (copia)"/  (upstream duplicate
                          directory, Spanish "(copia)" suffix — verbatim
                          copy of bitsequence/ that confuses any glob)
              libcds/src/**/Makefile  (per-subdir header-copy makefiles —
                          replaced by per-subdir -I paths in our CMake)
              *.o  (pre-built object files in upstream tree)

why_the_whole_tree:
            Only the Re-Pair grammar builder is used. A subset of the
            sources (Re-Pair grammar + DACs + supporting utilities, without
            FMINDEX/XBW/Hash/PFC/HTFC) cannot be built on its own:
            StringDictionary.h itself includes all 11 sibling type headers
            unconditionally at the bottom of the file, and
            StringDictionary.cpp::load() is a switch-on-type-tag factory
            that references every StringDictionary*::load static symbol.
            Compiling or linking a subset alone fails with missing-symbol
            errors at every sibling-type switch case. We therefore vendor
            and link the full libCSD tree as a single libcsd_static.a
            archive.

language:
            huff.cpp is C++ (suffix .cpp); no separate C-language target
            is needed.

licence_note:
            LGPL-2.1, the only non-permissive upstream of the benchmark.
            Static linking is permitted under LGPL section 6, which is
            satisfied by distributing this repository's full source, so
            that the binary can be relinked. Only the repair_runner
            binary, which links libcsd_static.a, inherits the obligation;
            the orchestrator and the other runner binaries are unaffected.

reproducibility_caveat:
            migumar2/libCSD has no upstream release tags (27 commits on
            master as of fetch_date). The commit_sha above is the
            authoritative version designator; reproducibility relies on
            the SHA pin + the SHA256SUMS manifest below.

sha256_manifest_path: third_party/libcsd/SHA256SUMS

local_patches (onpair_bench, NOT upstream): — StringDictionaryHTFC.cpp::decodeHeader heap-overflow fix.
            The decode scratch buffer was sized `4*maxlength + table->getK()`,
            too small for a bucket of long strings over a skewed byte alphabet
            (long Hu-Tucker codewords). On real ClickBench Title data this
            overflowed the heap; AddressSanitizer pinned a 2656-byte write past a
            4128-byte region in StatCoder::decodeString, surfacing as a
            "corrupted size vs. prev_size" SIGABRT when a decode op followed
            compress in the same process. Fixed by sizing the buffer for the true
            worst case: bucketsize*(maxlength+1) + 4*maxlength + getK() + 16.
            Regression: tests/pfc_htfc_htfc_overflow_test.cpp. This invalidates
            the StringDictionaryHTFC.cpp entry in SHA256SUMS (expected).
            NOTE: a SEPARATE, unfixed upstream libCSD HTFC decode-logic bug makes
            some long multi-byte (e.g. Cyrillic) strings decode lossily; the
            orchestrator's round-trip gate records those cells as status='lossy'.
